tools.name: check_price_history
tools.description: Say whether a product's cheapest current price is a good deal: its 60-day low and high, its typical price, and a verdict.

tools.name: price_shopping_list
tools.description: Price a whole shopping list or recipe in one call: up to 40 lines in plain words. Matches each line to a product, then totals the list at one named store, or finds the cheapest single store and any cheaper split across two or three stores. tools.name: compare_basket
tools.description: Total a basket of up to 30 products at each UK supermarket, name the cheapest single store, and suggest a split across two or three stores when it is cheaper or gets more of the list. Needs the user's MyGroceryPal account.

tools.name: save_shopping_list
tools.description: Add products to the user's MyGroceryPal shopping list, so they can open it in the app or on the web, and get deal alerts on saved products the way their MyGroceryPal notification settings say. Only adds: a product already on the list is left as it is. Needs the user's MyGroceryPal account.

tools.name: create_deal_alert
tools.description: Watch a brand or a keyword on the user's MyGroceryPal account, so they hear when a matching product goes on offer. Needs the user's MyGroceryPal account.
